sources.name: NHTSA Manufacturer Communications
sources.rule: Every manufacturer communication NHTSA added to its file in the window, all manufacturers.

sources.name: NHTSA Recalls
sources.rule: Every recall NHTSA received in the window: vehicles, equipment, tires and child seats.

sources.name: NHTSA Investigations
sources.rule: Every defect investigation NHTSA opened in the window.

sources.name: NHTSA Owner Complaints
sources.rule: A fixed sample of owner complaints added in the window: those whose NHTSA complaint number divides evenly by 13. Vehicle complaints only. A complaint whose text still contains an email address, a phone number, a full VIN, a case number or a street address is left out. The sample was not chosen to be representative.
